topic: reference period for departure holiday pay
snippet_a: The reference period is the qualifying year (N-1) for already-vested rights plus the running current year (N) pro-rata.
snippet_b: Double holiday pay on departure is calculated on the current calendar year's earnings only; the previous year is not relevant.

topic: deadline to notify the employer of illness
snippet_a: Notify the manager on the first day of absence, within one working day.
snippet_b: Notification should be given within two working days of the first day of absence.

topic: seniority threshold for the end-of-year premium
snippet_a: An employee must have at least 6 months of seniority in the reference year to receive a pro-rata premium.
snippet_b: A pro-rata end-of-year premium is due once an employee reaches 3 months of seniority.
